message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Constitution phase complete. Wrote /testbed/.specify/memory/constitution.md (91 lines) as v1.0.0, Ratified 2026-10-17, Last Amended 2026-10-17, using the scaffold resolved via `python3 .specify/scripts/python/resolve_template.py constitution-template --json`. Project name 'cachetools' chosen from the task. The five approved principles are codified as testable MUST/SHOULD rules: I. Preserve Existing Public API Behavior (LRUCache-based additive TaggedCache, upstream tests unchanged), II. Testable Acceptance Criteria (concrete observable criteria per requirement, verified via pytest against acceptance_public.py), III. Evidence Over Assertion (observed evidence vs unverified assertions, no claimed tests without command output), IV. Simple Scoped Implementation (src/cachetools/tagged.py, no new deps, YAGNI), V. Document Unresolved Assumptions and Regressions (HANDOFF.md/specs notes, per-requirement traceability). Added sections: Additional Constraints (feature dir specs/001-transactions, implementation source, no new dependencies), Development Workflow (phase order; implementation deferred to later phases; requirement-to-test traceability gate), Governance (amendment procedure, semver policy, phase-boundary compliance review, Next Actions for deferred intents). Sync Impact Report included as an HTML comment (temporary, to be removed before commit). Validation (command-verified): no remaining [BRACKET_TOKEN]s, version line matches report, ISO dates. No .specify/extensions.yml exists, so no pre/post hooks were checked or executed. No application source, tests, or templates were modified. Deferred non-governance intents (not executed per scope guard): (1) implement cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache per R01-R03 -> follow with $speckit-specify, then $speckit-plan/$speckit-tasks; (2) disposition of Claim-A candidate extension (variant put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21: put overwriting an existing key refreshes LRU recency) -> record as an assumption/extension decision in the spec phase. Suggested commit message: docs: ratify cachetools constitution v1.0.0 (five principles + governance)."}
